questions.question: Whom does God promise to send to prepare the way in Malachi 3?
options: A great army to drive out the enemies from the land
A righteous king to sit upon the great throne of David for ever and ever
My messenger, and the Lord whom you seek will come to his temple
A stern prophet of doom to warn the people of their sin
questions.answer: My messenger, and the Lord whom you seek will come to his temple

questions.question: What challenge about tithes does God give in Malachi 3?
options: Bring the full tithe into the storehouse, and test me, says the LORD
Fast and humble yourselves deeply in sackcloth for very many days
Offer up a full thousand rams and bulls upon the great altar of God
Build a temple far grander and more glorious than the very first one
questions.answer: Bring the full tithe into the storehouse, and test me, says the LORD
